owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

params.nonce: EIP-3009 nonce; doubles as commit nonce.
params.serviceId: Service key registered under that agent.
params.validBefore: EIP-3009 validity window end (also used as commit deadline).

returns.gross: Amount transferred in token smallest units.
The full price disbursed (sum of system + creator + agent legs).

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

registerServiceFromIdentity(uint256,addr.details: Validates `agentOwner` matches the on-chain `ownerOf` so a         compromised registry cannot register for an unrelated owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

selfRegisterCollection(address).details: Reverts with `ServiceAlreadyExists` on double-registration so         a compromised creator cannot rotate adapters silently — admin         escape hatch is `setCollectionWiring`.

setTokenAllowed(address,bool).details: Existing services retain their token even if it is later         delisted; only future registrations are blocked.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

returns.author: keccak256 of canonical author identity (Layer 2)
returns.contractName: canonical name of this contract (Layer 3 input)
returns.magic: steganographic magic baked in deployment bytecode (Layer 3)

PAYMENT_COMMITMENT_TYPEHASH().notice: EIP-712 typehash for the off-chain payment commitment.

VIMS_LICENSE().notice: keccak256("MIT") — license under which this code is published.

domainSeparator().notice: Convenience getter for the EIP-712 domain separator.

hashPaymentCommitment(uint256,bytes32,ad.notice: Compute the EIP-712 digest the payer must sign as the         purpose-binding commitment. Off-chain wallets / SDKs call this         (or replicate it) before signing.

hashPaymentCommitmentForNFT(address,uint.notice: EIP-712 digest the payer must sign as the purpose-binding         commitment for the NFT-scoped settlement path.

nftAdapters(address).notice: Adapter used to resolve owner / royalty / TBA for tokens in         each onboarded collection. Empty slot ⇒ collection unknown.

payForService(uint256,bytes32,address,ui.notice: Settle an x402 payment for a registered service with the         dual-signature scheme (EIP-3009 + EIP-712 commitment).

payForServiceForNFT(address,uint256,byte.notice: Settle an x402 payment for an NFT-scoped service. Mirrors         `payForService` but uses (nft, tokenId) as the addressing         scheme and resolves royalty / payout via the collection's         {IAgentNFTAdapter}.

quoteSplit(uint256,bytes32).notice: Quote the split for a hypothetical payment of `svc.price` units.

quoteSplitForNFT(address,uint256,bytes32.notice: Quote the disbursement split for an NFT-scoped service.         Returns 0/0/0/0 if the service is inactive — callers should         check `svc.active` separately if they need to distinguish.

registerService(uint256,bytes32,address,.notice: Register a new priced service for an agent.

registerServiceForNFT(address,uint256,by.notice: Register a priced service for a specific NFT token. Caller         must be the token owner OR the collection's trusted registrar.

registerServiceFromIdentity(uint256,addr.notice: Register a service on behalf of an agent owner. Only callable         by `trustedAgentRegistry` — the identity contract uses this         during `mintWithFullStack` so the atomic mint can include a         priced service without a second tx.

selfRegisterCollection(address).notice: Permissionlessly onboard an NFT collection. The caller must         be the collection's `collectionCreator()`. The collection         itself becomes both the {IAgentNFTAdapter} and the trusted         registrar — i.e. it can register services for any of its         tokens during the atomic mint flow.

setCollectionWiring(address,address,addr.notice: Owner-only escape hatch for wiring a collection that doesn't         self-adapt (separate adapter contract, partner registry, etc.)         or for rotating wiring after a migration.

setTokenAllowed(address,bool).notice: Allowlist (or remove) a token for use in `registerService`.

setTrustedAgentRegistry(address).notice: Owner-only setter for the trusted agent registry.

trustedAgentRegistry().notice: The `AgentIdentityRegistry` allowed to register services for         freshly minted agents on behalf of the owner during the         atomic `mintWithFullStack` flow. address(0) disables.

trustedRegistrarFor(address).notice: Address authorised to call `registerServiceForNFT` on behalf         of token owners for a given collection. After         `selfRegisterCollection`, this is the collection itself —         which lets `AgentCollectionImpl.mintAgentWithFullStack` wire         a service in the same tx as the mint.

updateService(uint256,bytes32,uint256,bo.notice: Update price / active flag on an existing service. Token is immutable.

updateServiceForNFT(address,uint256,byte.notice: Update price / active flag on an existing NFT-scoped service.         Token is immutable. Same auth as `registerServiceForNFT`.

vimsAttest().notice: Pure attestation function that defeats dead-code elimination on         the steganographic constants. Anyone (off-chain) can call this         to verify the bytecode they hold matches a canonical VIMS build.

vimsProvenance().notice: Returns the full VIMS provenance block for this contract.
